facts.value: The following documents are required for an application for the Master of Science in Business Administration.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: A bachelor's degree in a business-related program or a related field is required. This means that at least 90 ECTS in business modules must have been earned.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: Proficiency in English at a minimum level of B2 according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) is required.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: You can provide proof through: 1) A bachelor's degree completed in English; 2) Standardized language test with proof of B2 level; 3) English course at the university (e.g., Business English) stating B2 level; 4) High school certificate if English was studied until the Abitur.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: Language proof must not be older than 5 years.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: The following language proofs are not accepted: semester abroad, individual English modules in the bachelor's program, language courses without explicit level, CET-4 or CET-6.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: Examples of language tests and minimum scores for B2 level: 1) Cambridge Certificate: First Certificate in English (A-C); 2) DAAD Language Certificate: B2; 3) IELTS Academic: min. 5.0; 4) LCCI: EFB Level 3; 5) TOEFL: min. 72; 6) TOEIC: min. 785; 7) UNIcert: UNIcert II.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: If the examination board has doubts about an applicant's English language proficiency, admission may be granted with the condition of taking the TOEFL test by a specific deadline.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: Please submit a current CV outlining your main educational and professional experiences.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: A simple copy of your university entrance qualification (e.g., high school diploma) is required.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: International applicants must prove by the application deadline that they have passed the DSH-2 examination.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: Applicants with the following proofs may be exempt from the DSH-2 examination: 1) TestDaF: all exam results with at least TDN 4; 2) Goethe Certificate C2; 3) KMK examination: German Language Diploma Second Level (DSD II), consistently at C1 level; 4) DSH from other universities with a minimum level of DSH-2.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: DSH certificates obtained after January 1, 2013, are recognized only if registered by the Conference of University Rectors (HRK) according to the new framework regulation in German.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: Certificates such as KDS and GDS (Small/Large German Language Diplomas), ZOP (Central Advanced Examination), or university entrance qualifications from German-speaking countries (e.g., Austria) are accepted.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: With German knowledge at the B1/B2/C1 level, you can apply for a preparatory course for the DSH-2 examination during the application process.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: Admission to the preparatory course does not equate to admission to the master's program; you must reapply after passing the DSH examination.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: Applicants who completed their bachelor's studies in Vietnam, the People's Republic of China, or India need an APS certificate from the Academic Evaluation Center.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: Further information on DSH examination and preparatory courses can be found [here](https://www.uni-frankfurt.de/43662503/dsh). Additional information regarding language requirements is available [here](https://www.uni-frankfurt.de/65480053/200_Deutschkenntnisse).
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: For more information on the APS certificate and contact details for the Academic Evaluation Center in your country, visit [here](https://www.uni-frankfurt.de/134456293/APS_Zertifikat_der_Akademischen_Pr%C3%BCfstelle).
